description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin Space develops innovative, resilient solutions for space security and spacecraft missions. The Software Engineer will develop web applications and command-and-control capabilities within an Agile team, collaborating across the engineering lifecycle with development teams, customers, contractors, and subject matter experts.
Software engineer developing and testing classified command-and-control web applications

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with an exceptional team of Software Engineers implementing solutions and developing new features for a command and control application
• Serve as a software developer on an Agile team tasked with developing cutting edge web applications within multiple classification domains
• Participate in daily scrums, software sprint/release planning, demos, and retrospectives
• Develop & demonstrate software capabilities to both internal and external partners
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• * Experienced in software development using programming and scripting languages such as Java, JavaScript, C#, Python, etc
• * Experience working in an Agile development environment, including tools such as Jira and Confluence
• * US citizenship is required to obtain a government security clearance
• * Must have an active Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a SCI clearance
• * Generally has 1+ years of related experience and may have a post-secondary degree or training in a related discipline

Preferred:
• * Experience in application containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, etc.) in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/Openstack/Openshift)
• * Experience with frameworks such as .NET Core, Angular, etc
• * Experience with GitLab CI/CD - Deployment pipelines, automated build, and/or configuration tools
• * Experience with databases (PostgreSQL & Redis)
• * Strong knowledge of modern technology frameworks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, APIs, DevOps, and data architecture
• * Experience with modern engineering practices such as Cross-Functional Agile teams and Capability-based planning
• * Active TS/SCI security clearance
